scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Sharp bounds are restricted to the explicitly specified two frequency-coset Poisson system, integer translations and positive width. Qualitative frame existence for this semi-regular system is already a consequence of the motivating 2026 theorem, and is not claimed as new. An exhaustive historical check for implicit identical constants is unavailable; independent audit not performed.
title: Sharp two-coset Poisson Gabor bounds and the optimal half-offset
